instruction: Through the extension generator website, create a project titled "timer-app v0.8.0". Add description "Simple timing tool". Include browser action and content scripts, but omit background script and options page. Extract to "~/Projects".

metadata.explanation: This variation creates a timer-app extension with version 0.8.0, custom description, and includes browser_action and content_scripts. The evaluator checks the manifest.json for correct name, version, description, and presence of browser_action and content_scripts keys. Uses existing check_json metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: The instruction explicitly requires 'omit background script and options page', but the evaluator does not verify their absence

The evaluator only checks for the presence of required fields (name, version, description, browser_action, content_scripts) but ignores the explicit requirement to NOT include background and options_page
The task could incorrectly pass even if unwanted fields (background, options_page, options_ui) are present in the manifest.json
All other checks are semantically correct: name, version, description values are properly validated, and required fields existence is properly checked
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add 'unexpect' rules to check_json to verify the absence of forbidden fields
Add unexpect rule: {"key": ["background"], "method": "exist", "ref": null} to ensure background script is omitted
Add unexpect rule: {"key": ["options_page"], "method": "exist", "ref": null} to ensure options page is omitted
Add unexpect rule: {"key": ["options_ui"], "method": "exist", "ref": null} to ensure options UI is omitted (alternative options format)

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
